learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how to collect fun information and make beautiful picture charts!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Data is just a big smart word for information! We can collect data about what colors our friends like the most.
Instead of writing boring numbers, we can draw little pictures in boxes. One smiley face can mean one friend who loves apples!
By looking at our beautiful picture chart, we can quickly see which fruit has the most smileys and which has the least.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Shoe Chart
fun_activity.instructions: Count how many black shoes and how many blue shoes you have in your house. Draw a small picture chart on a paper to show the numbers!

quick_recap: ⭐ Data helps us understand the world by collecting information.
⭐ Picture charts make it very easy to read and understand numbers.
⭐ We can compare groups to see which is the biggest or the smallest.
